rows.name: Demon Blood
rows.description: +2 bonus on CL checks to penetrate a demon's SR, plus demons suffer -2 penalty on saves against user's spells and SLAs for 1 hour

rows.name: Amulet of the Abyss
rows.description: Functions as holy symbol of attuned demon lord, worshiper is aware of any action or item that could adversely affect his alignment and his standing with demon lord, all 3 SLAs from first demonic boon 1/day each

rows.name: Book of the Damned (Demonic)
rows.description: Contains every [Evil] spell plus SLAs, +4 bonus on Knowledge (planes) after consulting for 1 hr, teleporting to Abyss always arrives at exact location, permanent unhallow & sympathy to CE, +2 bonus to Charisma checks vs CE creatures, 3/day can cast one of variety of SLAs, 1/day as standard action gain any one demonic boon
